platform: Shopify (custom Tailwind theme by General Studios), Swiper 11+ for sliders, Plyr for video, no GSAP/Lenis

layout.max_width: none (full-bleed 1400 at 1440); text/promo inner 1200px at x120
layout.product_grid: 3 cols, gap-x 30px, gap-y 50px, card image aspect 380/370
layout.radius: buttons 0 (primary) or 4px (green/outline); pills 999px; review cards 4px; images 0
layout.button: padding 10px 40px, 1px border, black fill/white text, hover inverts; green 14px 28px

motion.mega_menu: 1s cubic-bezier(.41,.38,.14,1) open, .4s backdrop fade; close cubic-bezier(.82,.22,.65,.87)
motion.header: background .2s; hide on scroll down, show white fixed on scroll up
